title: Unified benchmark-definition file
description: One native definition file per benchmark, as a Kubernetes-style resource (apiVersion / kind / metadata / spec) consistent with the other compliancectl data files. Carries identity + inline rule payloads + generic metadata + flat axis:value tags. Produced by the Compliance Augmentation Engine and consumed by the compliance-engine-assessor as its input (replacing the MOF, which is retained only for Machine Configuration).

apiVersion.description: Versioned resource API group, e.g. 'compliance.osconfig.azure.com/v1'. Versions the file format, independently of the benchmark's own version.

name.description: Stable benchmark identifier (the benchmark selector label).

labels.description: Selectable identity axes (framework, os, distribution, distributionVersion, ...). Architecture-agnostic; the scanned host's arch is recorded in the assessor result, not here.

rules.description: One entry per rule in the selected benchmark.

section.description: Externally-quoted per-rule identifier (dotted CIS number or STIG id). Unique within a benchmark.

ruleId.description: Stable, benchmark-agnostic rule identifier (UUID derived from the payload key).

title.description: Human-readable rule title (section prefix + rule name).

tags.description: Flat, sparse set of framework-agnostic 'axis:value' tags.
